name: live-sports-only
label: Live Sports Only
desc: Quotes only markets that are both venue-declared in-play and classified sports/esports.
thesis: If the edge lives in live sports flow, quarantining the lane to in-play sports and esports should lift pair completion versus the rest of the board.
hypothesis: If the edge lives in live sports flow, quarantining the lane to in-play sports and esports should lift pair completion versus the rest of the board.

name: all-but-live-sports
label: All But Live Sports
desc: Quotes everything except in-play sports/esports: prematch sports, live non-sports, and the full regular book.
thesis: If adverse selection lives in live sports flow, excluding it while keeping the rest of the board should cut bail-out losses without starving volume.
hypothesis: If adverse selection lives in live sports flow, excluding it while keeping the rest of the board should cut bail-out losses without starving volume.
